column7: 2026-11-04: Encoding for inject() is undecided (regexparam vs our uploader client); user said hold off. Finding: plain encodeURIComponent does not match the storage service's signed path, because it leaves ! ' ( ) * unescaped and the service wants them as uppercase %XX. Fix in the caller: encodeURIComponent(s).replace(/[!'()*]/g, c => '%' + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).toUpperCase()). For '*' wildcard values, encode per segment so / is kept. Also fixed inject() dropping a 0 value (src/index.js), with tests in test/inject.js; uncommitted.
